thread:
maria: Heads-up — quick sync on audit logging gaps by service before we cut sprint.

sam: 👍 put together a short inventory, found holes in API gateway, auth, console, billing, runtime.

lee: can you paste the top missing events? I’ll pick runtime ones.

sam: API gateway: missing `gateway.request.forwarded` for certain proxied routes; also no 4xx/5xx body capture for proxy errors.

sam: Auth: login success/failure mostly covered, but RBAC change events (`rbac.role.change`) are not emitted from the console path.

anya: Billing: webhook retries/logging only show delivery status; we don't record `billing.invoice.view` or `billing.pricing.change` for customer-visible audit.

lee: Runtime: `model.load.failure` and `runtime.kvcache.evict` are inconsistent; some nodes log to local files only.

maria: Big themes: schema v1 is underspecified for customer-facing events, need `actor.id`, `actor.type`, `target.resource`, `outcome`, `request_id` across services.

maria: Proposed schema bump to `audit.v2` — backward compatible but strict validation on required fields for public events.

sam: +1. Need integration plan for KMS — who gets key-access audit events? e.g., `kms.key.decrypt` should be emitted from the KMS proxy, not the app.

anya: For RBAC change workflow, we should also emit `rbac.policy.applied` with `change_diff` redacted in prod for PII.

lee: For runtime local logs, I'll add a patch to ship those events to the centralized logger and tag with `node_id`.

maria: Can we get a short validation harness to run against customer-facing events? e.g., CI job that POSTs sample events and asserts schema + 200.

sam: I sketched a test harness: `tools/audit-validator` will take fixtures and run them through the validation lambda. I'll open PR.

maria: Good — also need incident hook: when a high-severity audit ingestion error occurs, pagerduty + ticket with sample failing payload.

audit-bot: rule `audit-mlt-validation` triggered — 3 events failed schema on staging at 2026-01-12T14:03:10Z.

anya: For backlog triage: propose labels `audit-gap:critical` (auth, billing), `audit-gap:owner-assigned` and `audit-gap:needs-spec`.

lee: I'll claim runtime ones. @sam pls claim API gateway + KMS mapping.

sam: Claiming API gateway + KMS mapping. Will add checklist item: publish mapping doc and sample event set.

maria: Owner assignments: runtime -> lee, api/gateway -> sam, auth/console -> anya, billing -> priya? (Priya to confirm)

anya: I'll loop in priya on billing. We should also schedule 30m spec review next Tue.

sam: FYI vuln triage: any audit gaps that impact forensics (missing events) become P0 if tied to auth/billing. Flagging that in notes.

maria: OK. Action items: 1) sam: PR for validator + mapping doc 2) lee: runtime log shipping patch 3) anya: console RBAC events + spec 4) priya: confirm billing events 5) me: schedule spec review and add PD rule for ingestion errors.

anya: :white_check_mark: I'll draft the RBAC event spec and include redaction guidance.

lee: I'll target a patch candidate by EOD Thu and link the PR.

sam: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/tools/pull/412 — contains validator and starter fixtures. Feedback welcome.

maria: perfect, thanks. Let's reconvene after PR review; I’ll update sprint board.

anya: tagging this thread for `audit` and `compliance` docs sync.

maria: closing loop — thanks all. :thumbsup:
